columns.title: Settling in
columns.description: Taken in by the plot and its people by the harvest, the winter still to face

columns.title: Second thoughts
columns.description: Letting the plot go, coming back, and keeping it as a need more than a wish

columns.title: Letting go
columns.description: Giving part of the plot, and what it stood for, over to others, and minding it

Hollis.note: Watched at the gate in March, carried by the old hands when his back went, home with news of his own, only the winter flat still in doubt.

Arlo.note: Taken on at his therapist's suggestion, let go over in the autumn, fetched back by Des's note, and kept because he needs it, not because he loves it.

Nell.note: A full plot taken for herself, the children and her buni's garden, the half like her buni's given away in November, failed and relieved, the rest the children's place.

note: An invented study, the demo's. Every participant and every word in it is made up.
